scope: GCN-extra unit-weight inference, not TFS-Train mathematics

findings.name: fixed_pair_factorial
findings.evidence: Thirteen methods: PACK plus adjacent and three prespecified complete-pair shuffles x modes0/3/4; pair direction, odd tail and AMX row slots preserved. No timing selects seeds or modes.

findings.name: exact_coverage_independent_CSR_audit
findings.evidence: Each shuffled plan maps mask bits with pair identity and independently recomputes every positive equal-length CSR window via memcmp. Exact edges/windows must equal adjacent statistics.

findings.name: same_storage_and_execution_object
findings.evidence: One scratch Plan; select only std::copy into unchanged-capacity buffers and updates same short-name Method.mode outside timing. Data pointers and object addresses logged each switch.

findings.name: actual_timed_path_equivalence
findings.evidence: Four extra boundaries compare actual fixed execution object with diagnostic Method. Outputs are poisoned between reference and actual runs to avoid stale-output false passes.

findings.name: controlled_work
findings.evidence: All orders at same mode must have identical source counters. Across modes adds/projections/state/prefetch stay fixed; ExactS alone saves c current CSR requests and c decodes.

findings.name: counter_coverage
findings.evidence: All13 methods x3 PMU reps per performance graph;32thread identities, enabled/running times, raw/scaled totals independently summed. Generic cache events and AMX busy cannot establish DRAM traffic or overlap.

findings.name: prespecified_expansion_filter
findings.evidence: Only s1ExactS vsPACK may trigger full17: diag4GM>=1.03 and wins>=3/4 in each of two protocols x two allocation classes. No substitution by better seed.

analyzer_smoke_selfcheck.note: In-memory invocation first omitted resolve() when constructing test run path and reported command-path alias mismatches; canonicalized run path as main() does, then all13 passed. No analyzer/kernel changes or result gating changes were made for this alias-only selfcheck issue.

limits: Source-identical core headers do not establish AVX-AMX overlap.
One warmup follows every switch; copy/hash work is outside clocks but its cache effects are controlled only by this declared warmed protocol.
Two new seeds are held out from earlier observation; graph family is not new and no universal robustness follows.
Interaction ratios and sample-extrema ranges are descriptive, not statistical confidence statements.
Separate allocation classes and protocols retain distinct denominators.
